meta.title: A Clash Of Wits
meta.description: The key to turning a situation around is remaining calm and collected even when you're a hair's breadth away from defeat.

units.rawText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.
units.displayText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

spans.text: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

units.rawText: The Professor's call to the Oasis is yet to be answered. The busy tone rings out into the emptiness, the surroundings reticent.
units.displayText: The Professor's call to the Oasis is yet to be answered. The busy tone rings out into the emptiness, the surroundings reticent.

spans.text: The Professor's call to the Oasis is yet to be answered. The busy tone rings out into the emptiness, the surroundings reticent.

units.rawText: The Oasis... Persicaria...
units.displayText: The Oasis... Persicaria...

spans.text: The Oasis... Persicaria...

units.rawText: Hehe, I take it that the surprise I prepared had its desired effect.
units.displayText: Hehe, I take it that the surprise I prepared had its desired effect.

spans.text: Hehe, I take it that the surprise I prepared had its desired effect.

units.rawText: You bastard...!
units.displayText: You bastard...!

spans.text: You bastard...!

units.rawText: Wow, don't give me that kind of expression. Don't forget what position you're in right now.
units.displayText: Wow, don't give me that kind of expression. Don't forget what position you're in right now.

spans.text: Wow, don't give me that kind of expression. Don't forget what position you're in right now.

units.rawText: I really must thank you for going through all that trouble to get that thing fixed, so that I may see these beautiful fireworks before I settle down to eat.
units.displayText: I really must thank you for going through all that trouble to get that thing fixed, so that I may see these beautiful fireworks before I settle down to eat.

spans.text: I really must thank you for going through all that trouble to get that thing fixed, so that I may see these beautiful fireworks before I settle down to eat.

units.rawText: Eucharist's gloating broke through the droning of the busy tone. The glint on her weapon glides across the agents behind me before landing squarely on me.
units.displayText: Eucharist's gloating broke through the droning of the busy tone. The glint on her weapon glides across the agents behind me before landing squarely on me.

spans.text: Eucharist's gloating broke through the droning of the busy tone. The glint on her weapon glides across the agents behind me before landing squarely on me.

units.rawText: Color. Aroma. All accounted for. Now, time to feast.
units.displayText: Color. Aroma. All accounted for. Now, time to feast.

spans.text: Color. Aroma. All accounted for. Now, time to feast.

options.rawText: Eucharist, I'll make you regret all you've done until now.
options.displayText: Eucharist, I'll make you regret all you've done until now.

spans.text: Eucharist, I'll make you regret all you've done until now.

units.rawText: Oh, don't give me the silent treatment. We're at the end of this whole business, so why don't you let me see some more interesting expressions, Professor?
units.displayText: Oh, don't give me the silent treatment. We're at the end of this whole business, so why don't you let me see some more interesting expressions, Professor?

spans.text: Oh, don't give me the silent treatment. We're at the end of this whole business, so why don't you let me see some more interesting expressions, Professor?

units.rawText: Rather than these meaningless indignities, I had hoped to hear something more interesting.
units.displayText: Rather than these meaningless indignities, I had hoped to hear something more interesting.

spans.text: Rather than these meaningless indignities, I had hoped to hear something more interesting.

units.rawText: Or—are these just your little tricks to stall for time?
units.displayText: Or—are these just your little tricks to stall for time?

spans.text: Or—are these just your little tricks to stall for time?

units.rawText: Antonina's hand tapping away at her terminal freezes. Eucharist raises her weapon nonchalantly, and with a flash of silver, her weapon pierces Antonina's terminal, pinning her to the ground at the same time.
units.displayText: Antonina's hand tapping away at her terminal freezes. Eucharist raises her weapon nonchalantly, and with a flash of silver, her weapon pierces Antonina's terminal, pinning her to the ground at the same time.

spans.text: Antonina's hand tapping away at her terminal freezes. Eucharist raises her weapon nonchalantly, and with a flash of silver, her weapon pierces Antonina's terminal, pinning her to the ground at the same time.

units.rawText: Gah...!
units.displayText: Gah...!

spans.text: Gah...!

units.rawText: I despise interruptions whilst in the middle of a meal. With how long we've known each other, did you really think these little things would escape my attention?
units.displayText: I despise interruptions whilst in the middle of a meal. With how long we've known each other, did you really think these little things would escape my attention?

spans.text: I despise interruptions whilst in the middle of a meal. With how long we've known each other, did you really think these little things would escape my attention?

units.rawText: Eucharist primes an operand blast at me, an apparently true hint of regret in her eyes.
units.displayText: Eucharist primes an operand blast at me, an apparently true hint of regret in her eyes.

spans.text: Eucharist primes an operand blast at me, an apparently true hint of regret in her eyes.

units.rawText: Can't say it was a long time, but it really was interesting to know you! When you're gone, I'll do my very best to cry a few tears and pretend that I was sad, at least for a little bit.
units.displayText: Can't say it was a long time, but it really was interesting to know you! When you're gone, I'll do my very best to cry a few tears and pretend that I was sad, at least for a little bit.

spans.text: Can't say it was a long time, but it really was interesting to know you! When you're gone, I'll do my very best to cry a few tears and pretend that I was sad, at least for a little bit.

units.rawText: Hah...
units.displayText: Hah...

spans.text: Hah...

units.rawText: What, you have anything to say?
units.displayText: What, you have anything to say?

spans.text: What, you have anything to say?

units.rawText: If you are so loathe to let this story end here, I'm inclined to agree.
units.displayText: If you are so loathe to let this story end here, I'm inclined to agree.

spans.text: If you are so loathe to let this story end here, I'm inclined to agree.

units.rawText: What?!
units.displayText: What?!

spans.text: What?!

units.rawText: <size=40>CLANG—</size>
units.displayText: CLANG—

spans.text: CLANG—

units.rawText: Eucharist backs away rapidly as a great shield tears through the air, embedding itself into the very earth between me and Eucharist as if a meteor from the heavens.
units.displayText: Eucharist backs away rapidly as a great shield tears through the air, embedding itself into the very earth between me and Eucharist as if a meteor from the heavens.

spans.text: Eucharist backs away rapidly as a great shield tears through the air, embedding itself into the very earth between me and Eucharist as if a meteor from the heavens.

units.rawText: Target signature successfully identified. Commencing capture.
units.displayText: Target signature successfully identified. Commencing capture.

spans.text: Target signature successfully identified. Commencing capture.

units.rawText: Watching as Eucharist's formerly gleeful smile freezes over, I take half a step back, moving aside for my guest from the shadows.
units.displayText: Watching as Eucharist's formerly gleeful smile freezes over, I take half a step back, moving aside for my guest from the shadows.

spans.text: Watching as Eucharist's formerly gleeful smile freezes over, I take half a step back, moving aside for my guest from the shadows.

units.rawText: I never imagined there would be more surprises for me at a moment like this. I admit I underestimated you.
units.displayText: I never imagined there would be more surprises for me at a moment like this. I admit I underestimated you.

spans.text: I never imagined there would be more surprises for me at a moment like this. I admit I underestimated you.

units.rawText: Lord Eucharist... no, Eucharist.
units.displayText: Lord Eucharist... no, Eucharist.

spans.text: Lord Eucharist... no, Eucharist.

units.rawText: Long time no see, Faith.
units.displayText: Long time no see, Faith.

spans.text: Long time no see, Faith.

units.rawText: CRASH—
units.displayText: CRASH—

spans.text: CRASH—

units.rawText: Before the conversation could continue, the two shields slam together again. As sparks fly forth, Eucharist's smile reclaims its spot on her face.
units.displayText: Before the conversation could continue, the two shields slam together again. As sparks fly forth, Eucharist's smile reclaims its spot on her face.

spans.text: Before the conversation could continue, the two shields slam together again. As sparks fly forth, Eucharist's smile reclaims its spot on her face.

units.rawText: Don't be so aggressive. A waitress putting up that kind of demeanor will scare away the guests.
units.displayText: Don't be so aggressive. A waitress putting up that kind of demeanor will scare away the guests.

spans.text: Don't be so aggressive. A waitress putting up that kind of demeanor will scare away the guests.

units.rawText: I thought the serving was done already. Do you intend to join us, Miss?
units.displayText: I thought the serving was done already. Do you intend to join us, Miss?

spans.text: I thought the serving was done already. Do you intend to join us, Miss?

units.rawText: If I don't allow Faith to leave the field temporarily, how am I to draw you out?
units.displayText: If I don't allow Faith to leave the field temporarily, how am I to draw you out?

spans.text: If I don't allow Faith to leave the field temporarily, how am I to draw you out?

units.rawText: Professor <cmdr>, enemy commander Odile has been confirmed to be eliminated. As of currently, the Rossum Sector crisis has been largely resolved. Allow me to express my thanks.
units.displayText: Professor {교수}, enemy commander Odile has been confirmed to be eliminated. As of currently, the Rossum Sector crisis has been largely resolved. Allow me to express my thanks.

spans.text: Professor
, enemy commander Odile has been confirmed to be eliminated. As of currently, the Rossum Sector crisis has been largely resolved. Allow me to express my thanks.

units.rawText: We merely had the same goals, and I owe my thanks for Eosphorus' acknowledgment and the Sanctifiers' support. What are your plans next? To garrison Rossum or return to the Reverse Babylon Tower?
units.displayText: We merely had the same goals, and I owe my thanks for Eosphorus' acknowledgment and the Sanctifiers' support. What are your plans next? To garrison Rossum or return to the Reverse Babylon Tower?

spans.text: We merely had the same goals, and I owe my thanks for Eosphorus' acknowledgment and the Sanctifiers' support. What are your plans next? To garrison Rossum or return to the Reverse Babylon Tower?

units.rawText: Our cooperation is at an end, and you have no right to know how the Sanctifiers will move next. If you are returning to the Oasis, however, I can spare a detachment to escort you.
units.displayText: Our cooperation is at an end, and you have no right to know how the Sanctifiers will move next. If you are returning to the Oasis, however, I can spare a detachment to escort you.

spans.text: Our cooperation is at an end, and you have no right to know how the Sanctifiers will move next. If you are returning to the Oasis, however, I can spare a detachment to escort you.

units.rawText: I think our cooperation may go further yet.
units.displayText: I think our cooperation may go further yet.

spans.text: I think our cooperation may go further yet.

units.rawText: Please do not use implications and metaphors so that we may avoid discrepancies in conveyed information.
units.displayText: Please do not use implications and metaphors so that we may avoid discrepancies in conveyed information.

spans.text: Please do not use implications and metaphors so that we may avoid discrepancies in conveyed information.

units.rawText: Cough... I mean to say that Odile was not only discreet in her tactical arrangements but that the intel in her possession was beyond our imagination. I worry there may be a further chain of command.
units.displayText: Cough... I mean to say that Odile was not only discreet in her tactical arrangements but that the intel in her possession was beyond our imagination. I worry there may be a further chain of command.

spans.text: Cough... I mean to say that Odile was not only discreet in her tactical arrangements but that the intel in her possession was beyond our imagination. I worry there may be a further chain of command.

units.rawText: I understand. What would you have of me?
units.displayText: I understand. What would you have of me?

spans.text: I understand. What would you have of me?

units.rawText: I'll have to take a bit of your time—play out this little farce with me.
units.displayText: I'll have to take a bit of your time—play out this little farce with me.

spans.text: I'll have to take a bit of your time—play out this little farce with me.

units.rawText: Well, well, well, most impressive, Professor. Faking that Faith had already departed, exposing your own position... you've really gone to a lot of trouble to see me.
units.displayText: Well, well, well, most impressive, Professor. Faking that Faith had already departed, exposing your own position... you've really gone to a lot of trouble to see me.

spans.text: Well, well, well, most impressive, Professor. Faking that Faith had already departed, exposing your own position... you've really gone to a lot of trouble to see me.

units.rawText: There's no need for these complicated schemes. You see, you could just put a piece of chocolate under a mounted box, and I'll be right there.
units.displayText: There's no need for these complicated schemes. You see, you could just put a piece of chocolate under a mounted box, and I'll be right there.

spans.text: There's no need for these complicated schemes. You see, you could just put a piece of chocolate under a mounted box, and I'll be right there.

units.rawText: I'll be sure to take note for next time. Since you're here already, I think it's time for a lot of questions to be answered.
units.displayText: I'll be sure to take note for next time. Since you're here already, I think it's time for a lot of questions to be answered.

spans.text: I'll be sure to take note for next time. Since you're here already, I think it's time for a lot of questions to be answered.

units.rawText: Greater Sanctifier [Eucharist], guilty of attacking non-abnormal agents, concealing identification, conspiracy against the Sanctifiers, associating with Daemons, and other offenses against the Sanctifier Code of Conduct, has committed 302 counts of breach of conduct.
units.displayText: Greater Sanctifier [Eucharist], guilty of attacking non-abnormal agents, concealing identification, conspiracy against the Sanctifiers, associating with Daemons, and other offenses against the Sanctifier Code of Conduct, has committed 302 counts of breach of conduct.

spans.text: Greater Sanctifier [Eucharist], guilty of attacking non-abnormal agents, concealing identification, conspiracy against the Sanctifiers, associating with Daemons, and other offenses against the Sanctifier Code of Conduct, has committed 302 counts of breach of conduct.

units.rawText: Initiating the Reverse Babylon Tower's Reverence Protocol. All Sanctifiers shall hereby designate [Eucharist] as a hostile entity.
units.displayText: Initiating the Reverse Babylon Tower's Reverence Protocol. All Sanctifiers shall hereby designate [Eucharist] as a hostile entity.

spans.text: Initiating the Reverse Babylon Tower's Reverence Protocol. All Sanctifiers shall hereby designate [Eucharist] as a hostile entity.

units.rawText: You heard her, Eucharist.
units.displayText: You heard her, Eucharist.

spans.text: You heard her, Eucharist.

units.rawText: I apologize, but I've no interest in your roleplay right now. Faith, I'll leave her to you. Antonina, we're going back to the Oasis.
units.displayText: I apologize, but I've no interest in your roleplay right now. Faith, I'll leave her to you. Antonina, we're going back to the Oasis.

spans.text: I apologize, but I've no interest in your roleplay right now. Faith, I'll leave her to you. Antonina, we're going back to the Oasis.

units.rawText: Target locked, commencing operation.
units.displayText: Target locked, commencing operation.

spans.text: Target locked, commencing operation.

units.rawText: Wai—
units.displayText: Wai—

spans.text: Wai—

units.rawText: As Faith issues the command, the Sanctifiers surge towards Eucharist. Their barrels prime themselves on the figure floating in the air, and a great cloud of fire and light swells—
units.displayText: As Faith issues the command, the Sanctifiers surge towards Eucharist. Their barrels prime themselves on the figure floating in the air, and a great cloud of fire and light swells—

spans.text: As Faith issues the command, the Sanctifiers surge towards Eucharist. Their barrels prime themselves on the figure floating in the air, and a great cloud of fire and light swells—

units.rawText: <size=40>BOOM!</size>
units.displayText: BOOM!

spans.text: BOOM!

units.rawText: Assault cycle 1, complete. Confirm target state.
units.displayText: Assault cycle 1, complete. Confirm target state.

spans.text: Assault cycle 1, complete. Confirm target state.

units.rawText: The smoke slowly dissipates in the air, concealing that minute figure.
units.displayText: The smoke slowly dissipates in the air, concealing that minute figure.

spans.text: The smoke slowly dissipates in the air, concealing that minute figure.

units.rawText: Target location... failed?!
units.displayText: Target location... failed?!

spans.text: Target location... failed?!

units.rawText: ...Haven't changed one bit, starting with arms instead of words.
units.displayText: ...Haven't changed one bit, starting with arms instead of words.

spans.text: ...Haven't changed one bit, starting with arms instead of words.

units.rawText: Professor! Incoming!
units.displayText: Professor! Incoming!

spans.text: Professor! Incoming!

units.rawText: CLANG—
units.displayText: CLANG—

spans.text: CLANG—

units.rawText: Gah—
units.displayText: Gah—

spans.text: Gah—

units.rawText: A blade comes forth from within the smoke. Faith clenches her teeth, barely blocking the blow while recoiling backward.
units.displayText: A blade comes forth from within the smoke. Faith clenches her teeth, barely blocking the blow while recoiling backward.

spans.text: A blade comes forth from within the smoke. Faith clenches her teeth, barely blocking the blow while recoiling backward.

units.rawText: I had hoped you'd be a bit different after being reset, but you're as single-minded as ever. Always holding onto these inexplicable beliefs... how unbelievably boring.
units.displayText: I had hoped you'd be a bit different after being reset, but you're as single-minded as ever. Always holding onto these inexplicable beliefs... how unbelievably boring.

spans.text: I had hoped you'd be a bit different after being reset, but you're as single-minded as ever. Always holding onto these inexplicable beliefs... how unbelievably boring.

units.rawText: Going on and on about defending Magrasea, and this is all you've got.
units.displayText: Going on and on about defending Magrasea, and this is all you've got.

spans.text: Going on and on about defending Magrasea, and this is all you've got.

units.rawText: ...Prepare for cycle 2, fire!
units.displayText: ...Prepare for cycle 2, fire!

spans.text: ...Prepare for cycle 2, fire!

units.rawText: The Lesser Sanctifiers around Faith unleash what firepower they have, but Eucharist withstands the attacks easily with an extended shield.
units.displayText: The Lesser Sanctifiers around Faith unleash what firepower they have, but Eucharist withstands the attacks easily with an extended shield.

spans.text: The Lesser Sanctifiers around Faith unleash what firepower they have, but Eucharist withstands the attacks easily with an extended shield.

units.rawText: Sigh... whether it's Faith or the Professor, neither of you understands the situation you're in.
units.displayText: Sigh... whether it's Faith or the Professor, neither of you understands the situation you're in.

spans.text: Sigh... whether it's Faith or the Professor, neither of you understands the situation you're in.

units.rawText: With this thing's help, all you've managed to accomplish is make me unable to kill you. That doesn't mean you have the upper hand, understand?
units.displayText: With this thing's help, all you've managed to accomplish is make me unable to kill you. That doesn't mean you have the upper hand, understand?

spans.text: With this thing's help, all you've managed to accomplish is make me unable to kill you. That doesn't mean you have the upper hand, understand?

units.rawText: ...Prepare cycle 3!
units.displayText: ...Prepare cycle 3!

spans.text: ...Prepare cycle 3!

units.rawText: Now then, a good doggy should sit by the side instead of interrupting their master, alright?
units.displayText: Now then, a good doggy should sit by the side instead of interrupting their master, alright?

spans.text: Now then, a good doggy should sit by the side instead of interrupting their master, alright?

units.rawText: The petite girl claps her hands. The previously scattered Entropics formed an orderly circle, slowly approaching.
units.displayText: The petite girl claps her hands. The previously scattered Entropics formed an orderly circle, slowly approaching.

spans.text: The petite girl claps her hands. The previously scattered Entropics formed an orderly circle, slowly approaching.

units.rawText: In contrast to Eucharist's aplomb, the grimace on Faith's face only grows more intense.
units.displayText: In contrast to Eucharist's aplomb, the grimace on Faith's face only grows more intense.

spans.text: In contrast to Eucharist's aplomb, the grimace on Faith's face only grows more intense.

units.rawText: ...Stop, Faith. Both sides will pay a great price if we continue.
units.displayText: ...Stop, Faith. Both sides will pay a great price if we continue.

spans.text: ...Stop, Faith. Both sides will pay a great price if we continue.

units.rawText: Both sides? Hehe, how optimistic of you.
units.displayText: Both sides? Hehe, how optimistic of you.

spans.text: Both sides? Hehe, how optimistic of you.

units.rawText: You've really created a mess for me, but it was a pleasant surprise, truly. I'll not delve into where exactly you've found this inexplicable confidence.
units.displayText: You've really created a mess for me, but it was a pleasant surprise, truly. I'll not delve into where exactly you've found this inexplicable confidence.

spans.text: You've really created a mess for me, but it was a pleasant surprise, truly. I'll not delve into where exactly you've found this inexplicable confidence.
Analyze the situation.
Analyze Eucharist's motivations.

units.rawText: (As Faith says, the Reverse Babylon Tower's already begun operations targeting Eucharist. The Entropics seem to be endless as well, but it looks as if the situation could swing either way.)
units.displayText: As Faith says, the Reverse Babylon Tower's already begun operations targeting Eucharist. The Entropics seem to be endless as well, but it looks as if the situation could swing either way.

spans.text: As Faith says, the Reverse Babylon Tower's already begun operations targeting Eucharist. The Entropics seem to be endless as well, but it looks as if the situation could swing either way.

units.rawText: (If Eucharist disregards defense and commits wholly to attacking me, the situation could become dangerous quickly.)
units.displayText: If Eucharist disregards defense and commits wholly to attacking me, the situation could become dangerous quickly.

spans.text: If Eucharist disregards defense and commits wholly to attacking me, the situation could become dangerous quickly.

units.rawText: (I'd really rather not, but it seems like negotiation is the only way out.)
units.displayText: I'd really rather not, but it seems like negotiation is the only way out.

spans.text: I'd really rather not, but it seems like negotiation is the only way out.

units.rawText: What do you want? Is your goal really to kill me?
units.displayText: What do you want? Is your goal really to kill me?

spans.text: What do you want? Is your goal really to kill me?

units.rawText:
Hehe, if you don't believe me, you can feel free to offer your little head...
Though, if you're asking, Professor, you probably have some idea, don't you?
units.displayText:
Hehe, if you don't believe me, you can feel free to offer your little head...
Though, if you're asking, Professor, you probably have some idea, don't you?

spans.text:
Hehe, if you don't believe me, you can feel free to offer your little head...
Though, if you're asking, Professor, you probably have some idea, don't you?

units.rawText: Alright, I'll stop messing with you. I am indeed here to get rid of you, but my boss knows that's too hard. There's only Faith here now, but who knows if some other virtue is going to pop up out of nowhere?
units.displayText: Alright, I'll stop messing with you. I am indeed here to get rid of you, but my boss knows that's too hard. There's only Faith here now, but who knows if some other virtue is going to pop up out of nowhere?

spans.text: Alright, I'll stop messing with you. I am indeed here to get rid of you, but my boss knows that's too hard. There's only Faith here now, but who knows if some other virtue is going to pop up out of nowhere?

units.rawText: So, my assignment today is actually pretty simple.
units.displayText: So, my assignment today is actually pretty simple.

spans.text: So, my assignment today is actually pretty simple.

units.rawText: Eucharist snaps her fingers, and a game piece appears in her hand.
units.displayText: Eucharist snaps her fingers, and a game piece appears in her hand.

spans.text: Eucharist snaps her fingers, and a game piece appears in her hand.

units.rawText: Let's play a game.
units.displayText: Let's play a game.

spans.text: Let's play a game.

units.rawText: Chess?
units.displayText: Chess?

spans.text: Chess?

units.rawText: Don't get it twisted. This isn't a hobby of mine. Just so happens that someone's played it with me before.
units.displayText: Don't get it twisted. This isn't a hobby of mine. Just so happens that someone's played it with me before.

spans.text: Don't get it twisted. This isn't a hobby of mine. Just so happens that someone's played it with me before.

units.rawText: Play along, okay? If you don't try to fight back, I won't attack you either.
units.displayText: Play along, okay? If you don't try to fight back, I won't attack you either.

spans.text: Play along, okay? If you don't try to fight back, I won't attack you either.

units.rawText: If you agree, I'll stop using that cannon over there.
units.displayText: If you agree, I'll stop using that cannon over there.

spans.text: If you agree, I'll stop using that cannon over there.

units.rawText: What does stalling for time do for you?
units.displayText: What does stalling for time do for you?

spans.text: What does stalling for time do for you?

units.rawText: There's no point to the riddle if I just tell you the answer. The cannon's in my hands, and I doubt your chances of holding out here are good. What other option do you have, Professor?
units.displayText: There's no point to the riddle if I just tell you the answer. The cannon's in my hands, and I doubt your chances of holding out here are good. What other option do you have, Professor?

spans.text: There's no point to the riddle if I just tell you the answer. The cannon's in my hands, and I doubt your chances of holding out here are good. What other option do you have, Professor?

units.rawText: Instead of brawling it out here, why don't we leave the fighting to the others and have a nice spot of relaxation here?
units.displayText: Instead of brawling it out here, why don't we leave the fighting to the others and have a nice spot of relaxation here?

spans.text: Instead of brawling it out here, why don't we leave the fighting to the others and have a nice spot of relaxation here?

units.rawText: ...Are you that intent on cutting me off from the battlefield?
units.displayText: ...Are you that intent on cutting me off from the battlefield?

spans.text: ...Are you that intent on cutting me off from the battlefield?

units.rawText: As self-centered as ever, I see.
units.displayText: As self-centered as ever, I see.

spans.text: As self-centered as ever, I see.

units.rawText: If you truly had control of Rossum and the Oasis, would you need to have this exchange with me?
units.displayText: If you truly had control of Rossum and the Oasis, would you need to have this exchange with me?

spans.text: If you truly had control of Rossum and the Oasis, would you need to have this exchange with me?

units.rawText: By going to these lengths to keep me here, you aim to strip the Oasis of its command and take me as a "hostage". Am I right?
units.displayText: By going to these lengths to keep me here, you aim to strip the Oasis of its command and take me as a "hostage". Am I right?

spans.text: By going to these lengths to keep me here, you aim to strip the Oasis of its command and take me as a "hostage". Am I right?

units.rawText: Eucharist's countenance freezes. She turns her eyes towards the piece in her hand—a white king.
units.displayText: Eucharist's countenance freezes. She turns her eyes towards the piece in her hand—a white king.

spans.text: Eucharist's countenance freezes. She turns her eyes towards the piece in her hand—a white king.

units.rawText: You've had a look at what state the Oasis is in, no? I don't think you've got the right to be this undisturbed.
units.displayText: You've had a look at what state the Oasis is in, no? I don't think you've got the right to be this undisturbed.

spans.text: You've had a look at what state the Oasis is in, no? I don't think you've got the right to be this undisturbed.

units.rawText: Do you really find the need to be this overbearing? All you've done is disrupt communication channels.
units.displayText: Do you really find the need to be this overbearing? All you've done is disrupt communication channels.

spans.text: Do you really find the need to be this overbearing? All you've done is disrupt communication channels.

units.rawText: Yeah, and? What can you do about it?
units.displayText: Yeah, and? What can you do about it?

spans.text: Yeah, and? What can you do about it?

units.rawText: Observing Eucharist's reaction closely, an answer reveals itself in my heart.
units.displayText: Observing Eucharist's reaction closely, an answer reveals itself in my heart.

spans.text: Observing Eucharist's reaction closely, an answer reveals itself in my heart.

units.rawText: Persicaria, do you read me? As projected, we have Eucharist where we want her. Is the Oasis ready?
units.displayText: Persicaria, do you read me? As projected, we have Eucharist where we want her. Is the Oasis ready?

spans.text: Persicaria, do you read me? As projected, we have Eucharist where we want her. Is the Oasis ready?

units.rawText: Wha...!
units.displayText: Wha...!

spans.text: Wha...!

units.rawText: Eucharist's pupils subconsciously shrivel as I lower my communications terminal.
units.displayText: Eucharist's pupils subconsciously shrivel as I lower my communications terminal.

spans.text: Eucharist's pupils subconsciously shrivel as I lower my communications terminal.

units.rawText: Looks like I was right. The Oasis hasn't fallen yet. Otherwise, you wouldn't be this nervous, right?
units.displayText: Looks like I was right. The Oasis hasn't fallen yet. Otherwise, you wouldn't be this nervous, right?

spans.text: Looks like I was right. The Oasis hasn't fallen yet. Otherwise, you wouldn't be this nervous, right?

units.rawText: Tch... hah. Haha, truly brilliant, Professor.
units.displayText: Tch... hah. Haha, truly brilliant, Professor.

spans.text: Tch... hah. Haha, truly brilliant, Professor.

units.rawText: What shall you do, then? If you insist on returning to the Oasis, I have no mercy left to show.
units.displayText: What shall you do, then? If you insist on returning to the Oasis, I have no mercy left to show.

spans.text: What shall you do, then? If you insist on returning to the Oasis, I have no mercy left to show.

units.rawText: Eucharist puts away the piece in her hand as the ranks of Entropics nearby shuffle and twist.
units.displayText: Eucharist puts away the piece in her hand as the ranks of Entropics nearby shuffle and twist.

spans.text: Eucharist puts away the piece in her hand as the ranks of Entropics nearby shuffle and twist.

units.rawText: I gaze at my terminal. The message I just sent has received no response.
units.displayText: I gaze at my terminal. The message I just sent has received no response.

spans.text: I gaze at my terminal. The message I just sent has received no response.
Analyze the Oasis.
Analyze Rossum.

units.rawText: (Before communications are restored, I hardly have a way to assist Persicaria.)
units.displayText: Before communications are restored, I hardly have a way to assist Persicaria.

spans.text: Before communications are restored, I hardly have a way to assist Persicaria.

units.rawText: (If I can occupy Eucharist here, Rossum might be spared from the fray.)
units.displayText: If I can occupy Eucharist here, Rossum might be spared from the fray.

spans.text: If I can occupy Eucharist here, Rossum might be spared from the fray.

units.rawText: (For me, a commander without the ability to command, to occupy the main enemy force as well as its officer...)
units.displayText: For me, a commander without the ability to command, to occupy the main enemy force as well as its officer...

spans.text: For me, a commander without the ability to command, to occupy the main enemy force as well as its officer...

units.rawText: ...Seeing as neither of us have leverage over the other, it seems we are both interested in a peaceful resolution to the problem.
units.displayText: ...Seeing as neither of us have leverage over the other, it seems we are both interested in a peaceful resolution to the problem.

spans.text: ...Seeing as neither of us have leverage over the other, it seems we are both interested in a peaceful resolution to the problem.

units.rawText: Phew... thought I'd have to do overtime. Couldn't you have just said that earlier?
units.displayText: Phew... thought I'd have to do overtime. Couldn't you have just said that earlier?

spans.text: Phew... thought I'd have to do overtime. Couldn't you have just said that earlier?

units.rawText: (But there's no chance Eucharist doesn't understand that. I can't be sure what her goals are in wasting time like this, so...)
units.displayText: But there's no chance Eucharist doesn't understand that. I can't be sure what her goals are in wasting time like this, so...

spans.text: But there's no chance Eucharist doesn't understand that. I can't be sure what her goals are in wasting time like this, so...

units.rawText: However, I have some other conditions.
units.displayText: However, I have some other conditions.

spans.text: However, I have some other conditions.

units.rawText: And why are you so sure I'll agree to them?
units.displayText: And why are you so sure I'll agree to them?

spans.text: And why are you so sure I'll agree to them?

units.rawText: It would not kill you to hear my terms.
units.displayText: It would not kill you to hear my terms.

spans.text: It would not kill you to hear my terms.

units.rawText: First, you must ensure the safety of Croque and her squad near the railgun.
units.displayText: First, you must ensure the safety of Croque and her squad near the railgun.

spans.text: First, you must ensure the safety of Croque and her squad near the railgun.

units.rawText: Well, well, I was worried she would go make trouble. If you intend to avoid conflict, Professor, I'm more than happy to oblige.
units.displayText: Well, well, I was worried she would go make trouble. If you intend to avoid conflict, Professor, I'm more than happy to oblige.

spans.text: Well, well, I was worried she would go make trouble. If you intend to avoid conflict, Professor, I'm more than happy to oblige.

units.rawText: Let me guess on your second condition... you want safe passage for another agent?
units.displayText: Let me guess on your second condition... you want safe passage for another agent?

spans.text: Let me guess on your second condition... you want safe passage for another agent?

units.rawText: Eucharist beams at Antonina, the latter still not moving an inch with a blade at her throat.
units.displayText: Eucharist beams at Antonina, the latter still not moving an inch with a blade at her throat.

spans.text: Eucharist beams at Antonina, the latter still not moving an inch with a blade at her throat.

units.rawText: I've known Antonina for quite some time, and I would be confident that she understands the concept known as "no backseating". You wouldn't wish for someone to prod away at you constantly while you're in the middle of a chess game, right?
units.displayText: I've known Antonina for quite some time, and I would be confident that she understands the concept known as "no backseating". You wouldn't wish for someone to prod away at you constantly while you're in the middle of a chess game, right?

spans.text: I've known Antonina for quite some time, and I would be confident that she understands the concept known as "no backseating". You wouldn't wish for someone to prod away at you constantly while you're in the middle of a chess game, right?

units.rawText: Hehe, when you put it like that, Professor, I can scarcely find a reason to say no.
units.displayText: Hehe, when you put it like that, Professor, I can scarcely find a reason to say no.

spans.text: Hehe, when you put it like that, Professor, I can scarcely find a reason to say no.

units.rawText: What'll it be, then?
units.displayText: What'll it be, then?

spans.text: What'll it be, then?

units.rawText: I shall prepare the board and snacks. I'll leave my Entropic friends here, so you'd better not make me wait, Professor~
units.displayText: I shall prepare the board and snacks. I'll leave my Entropic friends here, so you'd better not make me wait, Professor~
